liebermann.laws: VI Atr, IV Eg, Leis Wl
liebermann.notes: After a citation, L names the Latin version that Liebermann prints beside the text: for VI Atr the Latin paraphrase in MS K (VI Atr Lat, which has its own pages in the laws database), for IV Eg and for Leis Wl their Latin translations. So VI Atr 2 L is clause 2 of the Latin paraphrase. Not to be confused with the manuscript L used by Thorpe for ECf retr.
